claim: Round 2 native restic 0.19.1 backed up two synthetic WAL journals using CPython Online Backup pages=-1 during independently observed commits, checked subset 1/1, restored 16531456 identical journal bytes against the external inventory and required state, and refused native-exit-3 snapshot and same-count/same-integrity content-mutation restore controls. Dagu 2.16.6 validated the revised DAG and executed native manual skip/success/stale-input probes. 42 stdlib tests passed including real exchange_calendars 4.13.2 cases. Cron Next was not executable: no Go compiler found. Operating-host and off-host gates remain open.
limitations: Scratch local integration and synthetic fixtures, not an unchanged upstream test suite, real market/broker state or operating-host acceptance.
Per-journal Online Backup is consistent independently; no transaction across journals. Commits during the native call need not appear in its read snapshot; comparison uses the frozen snapshot oracle.

Native check subset 1/1 reads every pack in this small proof. Whole seven-part/seven-day rotation, daily jitter, fall-back and deadlines are behavioural stdlib tests; operator execution is still required.
No scheduler or systemd unit installed, enabled or started; the operating-host restart/reboot/missed-run and independent-alert gates remain user decision 2.
Native Dagu probes use manual start, not scheduler dispatch. Scheduler run_dags:false behavior still needs the future host drill; a succeeded run with skipped research steps cannot count.
Off-host recovery requires user decision 3: independent destination, key recovery and second-host consumer restore under a chosen/measured recovery-time objective.
No retention deletion, broker, live credentials/mode, model calls, commit, push or manifest pin move.
Python 3.11 minimum is source-verified and syntax-checked. Execution used 3.13.15; no separate 3.11 interpreter was exercised.
robfig/cron v3.0.1 Next program/module were prepared from tagged source, but go run exited 127 because the compiler was not found; expected DST values are not measured results.

upstream_glue_choices.checked: restic stdin-from-command, SQLite CLI .backup/.dump, SQLite sqlite3_rsync, CPython Online Backup and subprocess timeout.
upstream_glue_choices.why: Native operations do the copying/backups/checks/restores; consumer glue freezes the external oracle and required tables, rotates checks with a deadline and refuses controls.
Replace exclusive-create sentinels with nonblocking process-owned flock; stale file survives safely and no custom stale-lock recovery runs.

upstream_glue_choices.why: Upstreams own supervision and run records; identity/time/holiday guards and exact due-slot correlation are our acceptance procedure.

upstream_glue_choices.why: Synthetic concurrent WAL writers, failures preserving integrity/counts and path-free integration evidence are consumer acceptance rather than replacement backup tools.
